items.title: Special voter-enrolment drives planned
items.summary: A report dated 15 October said Meghalaya and other election authorities were arranging enrolment drives for eligible people whose names were missing from electoral rolls, with Meghalaya camps planned after 26 October. Check the latest official election notice for any schedule changes.
items.exam: Electoral rolls, voter registration and election administration.
items.verificationStatus: dated-report-reviewed; confirm schedule against official notice

items.title: Direct-tax collections rise year on year
items.summary: Financial Express reported net direct-tax collections of ₹13.38 lakh crore after refunds as of 14 October 2026, up 13.2% year on year. The same report distinguished this from ₹16.03 lakh crore collected before refunds.
items.exam: Direct and indirect taxes, gross versus net collections, tax administration.

items.title: CERN and Mistral AI announce physics-focused model partnership
items.summary: Reuters reported that CERN and Mistral AI plan to develop an AI foundation model for scientific discovery, initially focused on collider physics and trained using simulated particle-collision data. No launch date or budget was specified in the report.
items.exam: AI for science, particle physics, CERN and international research partnerships.

items.title: Shai Hope scores an unbeaten century against India
items.summary: Reuters reported that West Indies captain Shai Hope scored 102 not out in the fourth T20 International in Hyderabad, helping West Indies level the series. Match and series facts can change as later fixtures are played.
items.exam: Cricket current affairs, match formats and individual performance.
